chapters.title: Is it up?
narration: This is the server behind my apps, on a machine at home, through its own dashboard.
First, whether it answered all week, and how long since it last restarted.

chapters.title: Saying no
narration: A server also has to say no: a rate limiter per client, and refusals when it is too busy.
These panels count what it turned away last week, and why.
